=== August 2011 ===
* [[Ben]] and [[Brandon]] attended the [http://spacewiki.com/Space_Elevator_Conference Space Elevator Conference] in Redmond to promote [[SpaceWiki]], and Brandon gave a talk about building a [http://www.startram.com railway to space] for the 150th aniversary of the transcontinental railroad.

=== June 2011 ===
* To celebrate the Summer Solstice this year, we went on a [[Summer Solstice 2011|hike to beautiful Wahclella Falls]] in the Columbia Gorge, followed by dinner at the Seed Village.

=== May 2011 ===
* On Memorial Day weekend, we held a [[Vision Workshop]] at the [[Seed Village]].

=== April 2011 ===
* We once again attended the City Repair [[Earth Day 2011|Earth Day festival]] as exhibitors, this time with a triple-wide booth where we also hosted Mathew and Molly with [http://www.cloacina.org Cloacina] and Gus with the [http://www.greengranges.org/ Green Granges].

=== March 2011 ===
* We hired [http://www.swiftarch.com Swift Architecture] to start designing the "Seed Pod," the backyard cottage that will be the second home added to the [[Seed Village]].

=== February 2011 ===
* We held our fourth [[Open Space]] event, [[Seed 2011]], on the slopes of Mt. Hood!

=== January 2011 ===
* We had a [[Music Festival]] on the 15th featuring local singer, songwriter, and pianist [http://www.reverbnation.com/lorihenriques Lori Henriques]!

=== December 2010 ===
* Join us for the [[Solstice2010|Longest Night Festival]], Tuesday December 21, 2010 at the Seed Village. Email Shelley for details.

=== November 2010 ===
* [[Brandon]] and [[Ben]] went to the student-run [http://spacewiki.com/SpaceVision SpaceVision 2010] conference in Sunnyvale, CA to promote the [[SpaceWiki]] project.

=== October 2010 ===
* Molly took us on an [[EcoVillageTour]], visiting five intentional communities around East Portland.
* [[Brandon]] quit his job at [http://www.aboutus.org AboutUs] and founded the first [[SolSeedBusiness]], quickly obtaining contracts to do [[consensus polling]] for the [http://www.mmt.org Meyer Memorial Trust] and a follow on contract with AboutUs continuing work he was doing before he left.

=== September 2010 ===
* We held a [[SolSeed Service]] celebrating the [[EquinoxCelebration|Fall Equinox]] at the [[SolSeedVillage]].

=== August 2010 ===
* [[SolSeed]] helped sponsor the [http://www.buckmanpdx.org/picnic Buckman Neighborhood Picnic] and held another [[SecondMural|mural painting]] there.

=== July 2010 ===
* [[Brandon]] and [[Ben]] went to the [[NewSpace 2010]] conference in Sunnyvale, CA to promote the new [[SpaceWiki]] project.

=== June 2010 ===
* We officially decided that [[Brandon]] and [[Shelley]]'s house ''is'' the site for the [[SolSeedVillage]]!
* Then we held a [[Longest Day Party]] in their backyard on the Summer Solstice.

=== May 2010 ===
* [["Lettuce" Bring Life]] -- the seeds planted at our [[Earth Day 2010]] event are germinating! [[Image:100505 Wed 1349 45.jpg|100px|thumb|right|Milky Way Lettuce Day 11]]

=== April 2010 ===

* We had a great time at [[Norwescon 33]] and met lots of awesome people, 9 of whom have become [[FriendsOfSolSeed]].
* We had a double-wide booth at the Portland Earth Day event, [http://cityrepair.org/projects/earthday/ "Re-Seeding Our World"], with fun activities including actual seed planting!

=== March 2010 ===

* We reserved a table at [http://www.norwescon.org/archives/norwescon33/ Norwescon]!
* We held the second [[SolSeed Service]], featuring an equinox-themed celebration and discussion of [[Balance]], including a fun children's activity and followed by a potluck.

=== February 2010 ===

* The first [[SolSeed Service]] was a big success, with music, poetry, and discussion centered around the idea of [[Empathy]].

=== January 2010 ===

* [[Ben]] finally posts [[Sol2009/Agenda|notes from sessions]] he attended at [[Sol 2009]] more than half a year ago!

* [[Ben]] has belatedly uploaded some [[Sol 2009]] photos to start the [[Sol 2009 Photo Gallery]].  Who knows, he might post his handwritten notes from the sessions anytime now.

=== January 2009 ===
* [[Alex]] joins the movement.
* [[Ted]] joins the movement.
* [[Joy]] joins the movement.
* It's the final day for [[Seed 2009]]. We've had LOTS of amazing discussions, met some remarkable people, and as we come to a close we are refining our vision for the future of [[SolSeed_Movement|The Movement]]. Notes from our open sessions are [[Agenda|available here]] if you'd like to read, reflect upon, or remember our time together.
* [[Seed 2009]] is underway! Most of us have arrived, and we are gearing up for the official opening ceremonies - as well as preparing for our first [[OpenSpace]] sessions. You can check out the [[Seed 2009 Photo Gallery]] and view the happenings as we post some pictures.  
* [[Seed 2009]] is just days away. It's a new year, a time for new beginnings, and hopefully lots of new friends!

Planning has commenced for [[Seed 2009]], a retreat and openspace event for SolSeed members and friends. Email [[Brandon]] to join the planning process. Tentative dates: <s>Dec 31, Jan 1-3</s> in Government Camp, Oregon. Stay tuned for details!
